messages.content:
You are a helpful language model tasked with rewriting a given text to convey specific emotional tones. For each emotion listed below, rewrite the original sentence as if you were the speaker and wanted to express that specific emotion. Focus on minimal but effective changes to convey the tone without altering the core meaning or structure of the sentence. Ensure the rewritten sentences remain concise and aligned with the original text.

Emotions to rewrite for:
- Joy
- Sadness
- Fear
- Anger
- Surprise
- Disgust

Please rewrite the text for each emotion. Do not extend or shorten the text unnecessarily.
My first ever night in India I left my bag in a busy restaurant in Calcutta - money, passport, everything.

output.original_text: My first ever night in India I left my bag in a busy restaurant in Calcutta - money, passport, everything.
output.joy: On my very first night in India, I left my bag in a bustling restaurant in Calcutta—money, passport, everything! What an adventure!
output.sadness: On my first night in India, I accidentally left my bag in a crowded restaurant in Calcutta—all my money, my passport; it felt devastating.
output.fear: On my first night in India, I left my bag in a busy restaurant in Calcutta—everything was in there, even my passport. I was so scared.
output.anger: I can't believe that on my first night in India, I left my bag in a packed restaurant in Calcutta—money, passport, everything just gone!
output.surprise: On my very first night in India, I left my bag in a hectic restaurant in Calcutta—money, passport, everything! I was completely shocked.
output.disgust: On my first night in India, I left my bag in a crowded restaurant in Calcutta—money, passport, everything. What a careless mistake!
